notes.title: Version 0.0.8 Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
11 New Weapons Added: Micro Missile Launcher, Sticky Bomb Bow, Flamethrower, Frost Launcher, Venom Sprayer, Laser Gun, Ray Gun, Sonic Gun, Railgun, Aura Gun, and Crossbow.

Weapon Quality System: Dropped weapons now have random qualities. High-quality weapons will come with randomly generated affixes.

New Gameplay Option: Added an option in the settings menu to enable or disable automatically switching back to the starter pistol when out of ammo.

Optimizations & Bug Fixes: Implemented performance optimizations and fixed several known bugs.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.7 Update
notes.notes:
(1) Significantly increased the reflect damage of Character "Huang"'s stance skill.

(2) Added a short period of invincibility after Character "Huang"'s stance ends.

(3) Weakened the charge effect of the Level 2 wild boar.

notes.title: Demo v0.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed a bug that occurred when refreshing mutation skills after they reached the max level of 5.

All blade shockwaves can no longer pass through walls.

Fixed a bug where crystals could not be picked up.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
Fixed a bug where the boss's skill animations were not playing correctly.

Fixed an issue where the boar boss's charge skill could incorrectly destroy indestructible boundary walls.

Replaced the background music for the second boss battle.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
Added a new UI notification for ultimate ability readiness.

Optimized bullet/projectile performance.

Fixed a bug where Character 1 could revive while rolling.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[olist]
New Mechanic: The "Splitting Bugs" in Level 1 can now be executed.

Boss Adjustments: Slightly reduced the rocket projectile speed for Boss 1 during Phase 2.

Character Balance: Increased the melee basic attack damage for the character "Ah Huang".

QoL Improvement: Expanded the vertical camera follow range to provide a wider field of view.

Bug Fixes: Fixed several known bugs and made general performance optimizations.
[/olist]
